steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: We've reached the designated location. Pylgia, set up the first security perimeter.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Roger.
Through the monitor, you see Pylgia holding a metallic portable, flips the switch, and places it in the water.
To your surprise, the device hovers at where it's deployed instead of sinking, emanating an ethereal blue glow.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: You mean the alarm? Oh, just a gadget the tech team cooked up using some glowing blue crystals.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: This is also part of the job—we've got some sketchy stuff happening down here lately. If any weird creatures swing by, it'll set off an alarm to give the surface teams a heads-up to clear out.

Through the device's dial, you catch sight of the shimmering blue crystals Ragnar spoke of. Although their crystal structure resembles that of a Hypercube, their appearance is vastly distinct—more like flowers blossoming on a plant.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I thought we'd run into some monsters on our way down.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Heh, hold your horses. Won't be long.
[Switch Scene]

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Eleven o'clock, evade.
Ragnar wrenches the helm hard to starboard. Less than two seconds later, a grotesque creature—deathly pale with limbs that seem grafted from various sea creatures—glides right past the porthole.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Pylgia, Dale, keep an eye out! These things are quick—I'm ready to fire at any second!

steps.speaker: Dale
steps.content: Copy that.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Pylgia, do you copy? ...Pylgia? Pylgia!
Something is fast approaching, another one from the left side.
You rush to the porthole, only to find Pylgia utterly motionless as another pale creature charges towards her at a terrifying pace.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Watch out!
You can't help but shout out, trying to warn Pylgia of the creature's attack. However, clearly seeing the approaching threat, she makes no attempt to dodge—instead, she stretches her hand.

In the next moment, an astonishing sight unfolds before you: the creature slows down as if restrained by an invisible force, eventually suspended right in front of Pylgia. They fall locked in an uncanny standoff.

Then, an impossibly high-frequency, almost imperceptible piercing sound reaches your ears. Influenced by this seemingly illusory noise, the creature—which had been charging forward in a frenzy moments ago—begins to retreat as if "persuaded" by Pylgia.
Suddenly, Dale's voice cuts through, interrupting the sound.

steps.speaker: Dale
steps.content: Pylgia, clear out!
Before you realize it, Dale has already moved to Pylgia's side, his sharp underwater weapon firing straight through the creature.
The creature writhes violently, letting out a blood-curdling shriek. In the meanwhile, countless inhuman eyes emerge from the darkness, all fixed on the submarine.
